tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Shanghai Masters Day 7: Ben Shelton opens against Arthur Gea at noon local before Hurkacz–Zhou, with Alexander Zverev vs Quentin Halys not before 18:00 and Davidovich Fokina–Tiafoe on Stadium Court • [SQUASH] CIB Egyptian Squash Open Round Two Sunday at O West—Mostafa Asal meets Joachim Chuah, Paul Coll faces Yannick Wilhelmi, and Marwan ElShorbagy–Karim El Hammamy tops the men's slate after opening-round upsets • [BADMINTON] Arctic Open finals day in Vantaa: Anders Antonsen rallied past Lee Zii Jia to face Yushi Tanaka, while Mia Blichfeldt and Ratchanok Intanon headline the women's singles title match • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Chicago Cup Championship Sunday at Life Time Northbrook—gates 10:00 AM CT with all five pro finals best-of-three on PickleballTV, Tennis Channel, and FS1 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT China Smash finals in Beijing: Wang Manyu chases another women's singles crown against Hitomi Sato as Kuai Man–Wang Manyu and Lim Jong-hoon–Oh Junsung lift doubles titles

newsItems.title: Zverev Leads Shanghai Day 7
newsItems.excerpt: Round-of-32 Sunday at the Rolex Shanghai Masters features Ben Shelton vs Arthur Gea from 12:00, Hubert Hurkacz vs Yi Zhou, and Alexander Zverev vs Quentin Halys not before 18:00 on Stadium Court.

newsItems.title: Antonsen Into Arctic Final
newsItems.excerpt: Anders Antonsen edged Lee Zii Jia 21-11 15-21 21-16 in Vantaa and meets Yushi Tanaka on Championship Sunday, while Mia Blichfeldt and Ratchanok Intanon contest the women's singles final.

newsItems.title: Chicago Cup Finals Sunday
newsItems.excerpt: The Veolia Chicago Cup wraps with Championship Sunday at Life Time Northbrook—gates at 10:00 AM CT and five pro finals in best-of-three format on PickleballTV, Tennis Channel, and FS1.

newsItems.title: China Smash Crowns Champions
newsItems.excerpt: WTT China Smash finals day in Beijing sees Wang Manyu face Hitomi Sato for the women's singles title after Kuai Man–Wang Manyu won doubles gold and Lim Jong-hoon–Oh Junsung took men's doubles.
